narrative.overview: roster is a map of your network you can step into. Hosts are nodes, Sessions are edges drawn from this Box to them, and the Gap orbit mark is the motif carried everywhere instead of decoration. Everything else is a near-black instrument panel that gets out of the way, because the terminal is the hero. The surface is dark, flat and dense; colour is almost absent and apricot appears only where something is live or actionable now. Controls are machined and tactile, with a terminal's crispness: keyboard moves land instantly, as in Neovim. Every token is a default the user can change through Themes, init.lua and Plugins.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black graphite layers (Ink to Raised Graphite), separated by hairlines.
One accent, Apricot flare, spent only on what's live or actionable.
Two voices of type: Iosevka for anything you could paste into a shell, Inter for the app talking to you.
State shown by node shape (filled, ring, dashed, hollow), never by colour alone.
Keycaps beside every action: keyboard discoverability is the onboarding.
Motion of 150 ms or less, ease-out, transform and opacity only, and it confirms cause and effect.

rules.name: The Accent Means Live Rule
rules.body: Apricot is spent only on what's connected or actionable now. Nothing decorative is apricot. Test: on a screen with no live Session, the accent should be nearly absent.

rules.name: The Place-Not-Action Rule
rules.body: Sea Glass marks where (this Box, an unreviewed Host) and is only ever a shape. If you could click it or read it, it isn't Sea Glass.

rules.name: The Faint-Is-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Faint Pewter fails 4.5:1 by design. Text that needs to be quiet uses Muted Pewter.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: No component names a colour. Every colour is a Theme token, so a Theme or Plugin can restyle everything.

rules.name: The Paste Test Rule
rules.body: If it's something you could paste into a shell, it's in Iosevka. Everything else is Inter.

rules.name: The Never-Cut-Mid-Token Rule
rules.body: IPs, ports and fingerprints are never truncated mid-token. Data cells use tabular numbers, and the selected row shows its whole name, wrapped.

rules.name: The Terminal-Is-The-Hero Rule
rules.body: Chrome recedes. If a pixel isn't helping you reach or use a shell, it's quiet.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Resting UI never casts a shadow. A shadow means "this is floating over your terminal and will go away."

rules.name: The Nodes-And-Edges Rule
rules.body: The network's own shapes are the only ornament. The Gap orbit mark appears small and still (48 to 64px, muted) in empty states and on the lock screen, and is never used as wallpaper.

rules.name: The Instant Keys Rule
rules.body: What a key moves, it moves immediately: the Sidebar cursor, the live bar, the Picker's selection and the command line's completions don't animate. Motion is kept for things that arrive or connect (a panel entering, an edge drawing), never for keyboard navigation. Test: holding j should feel like scrolling a buffer, not watching a transition.

rules.name: The Modal Clarity Rule
rules.body: The current mode is always readable at a glance in the status line (Inter 600, tracked 0.04em, Apricot Ink). Every command has a : form that completes, as in Neovim.

dos: Do use the raised style (Raised Graphite plus a 1px inset Raised Line) for selection, and add the 2px apricot bar only for the live Session.
Do put Host names, IPs, ports, keys and commands in Iosevka 500 with tabular figures, at Muted Pewter for secondary data.
Do show state with node shape (filled, ring, dashed, hollow) plus words, never colour alone.
Do put the keycap for the next action beside every empty state, footer and menu item.
Do make keyboard navigation instant (no transition on cursor, selection or live-bar moves), as in Neovim.
Do keep motion under 150ms, ease-out, transform and opacity only, interruptible and off under reduced motion.
Do draw every colour from a Theme token so init.lua, Themes and Plugins can restyle it; Plugin UI uses the same tokens and components as built-ins.
Do use the Gap orbit mark small (48 to 64px) and still, at reduced opacity, for empty states and the lock screen.
donts: Don't spend apricot on anything that isn't live or actionable now. No decorative accent.
Don't use Faint Pewter for text, or Sea Glass for text or anything clickable.
Don't add shadows, gradients, glows or glass to resting surfaces. Shadows are for floating surfaces only.
Don't use spinners where an edge or node can show progress, or toasts for errors that belong in place.
Don't add celebratory motion, bouncy springs, confetti or emoji in our own copy.
Don't build "dashboard" cards or charts. roster is a map and a terminal.
Don't truncate an IP, port or fingerprint mid-token.
Don't animate the lock cover. It's instant.
